nodes.description: Public address holding the current owner of the Owned contract; reference for the onlyOwner access-control check.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public ERC20 token symbol string, set to ARM1 in the constructor.
Public ERC20 token name string, set to Armatura1 in the constructor.
Public ERC20 decimals value, set to 4 in the constructor.
Total token supply state variable, initialized to 50000000000 in the constructor.
Mapping address to uint holding token balances of every account.
Nested mapping owner to spender to uint holding ERC20 allowances.
Owned() constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment time.
onlyOwner modifier that requires msg.sender to equal the stored owner address.
Owner-only function that stages a new owner in newOwner; ownership is not transferred until acceptOwnership.
Completes ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner then sets owner and clears newOwner.
SafeMath addition helper returning a + b with an overflow require check.
SafeMath subtraction helper returning a - b with an underflow require check.
SafeMath multiplication helper returning a * b with an overflow require check.
SafeMath division helper returning a / b with a divide-by-zero require check.
ARM1Token() constructor that sets token metadata and mints the entire supply to msg.sender.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked arithmetic operation.
Constant function returning the token balance of tokenOwner.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub and safeAdd; emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to tokens and emits Approval.
Spends an allowance to move tokens from from to to, updating balances and allowed with SafeMath; emits Transfer.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets an allowance and then performs an external call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
Owner-only function performing an external call to an arbitrary ERC20 contract to sweep tokens from the contract.
Caller-controlled msg.sender value used for ownership checks, minting, allowances and balance debits.
Arithmetic operation c = a + b inside safeAdd performed before the overflow require check.
Arithmetic operation c = a - b inside safeSub performed before the underflow require check.
Arithmetic operation c = a * b inside safeMul whose result is validated afterwards.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply, not routed through SafeMath.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an arbitrary spender contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary token contract supplied by the owner.
Recipient address parameter to of the transfer function.
Amount parameter tokens of the transfer function.
Spender address parameter of the approve function.
Amount parameter tokens of the approve function.
Source address parameter from of the transferFrom function.
Destination address parameter to of the transferFrom function.
Amount parameter tokens of the transferFrom function.
Spender address parameter of approveAndCall; also the target contract of the external call.
Amount parameter tokens of the approveAndCall function.
Arbitrary bytes parameter data forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary token contract address parameter of transferAnyERC20Token; target of the external call.
Amount parameter tokens of transferAnyERC20Token.
Account address parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf.
Owner address parameter tokenOwner of allowance.
Spender address parameter of allowance.
Candidate owner address parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership.

edges.reason: Owned() sets owner = msg.sender, making the deployer the privileged address.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner, gating privileged functions on caller identity.
onlyOwner modifier guards transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier guards transferAnyERC20Token.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before changing ownership.
ARM1Token constructor mints the whole supply to balances[msg.sender].
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and credits the recipient.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the external call.
owner state variable is the right-hand side of require(msg.sender == owner).
newOwner state variable is compared with msg.sender in acceptOwnership.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and subtracts balances[address(0)] without SafeMath.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
constructor assigns symbol = ARM1.
constructor assigns name = Armatura1.
constructor assigns decimals = 4.
constructor initializes _totalSupply = 50000000000.
transfer calls safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub on source balance and allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd on the destination balance.
totalSupply performs the unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
safeAdd executes c = a + b before verifying c >= a.
safeSub executes c = a - b before verifying b <= a.
safeMul executes c = a * b and then validates the product.
approveAndCall transfers control to an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token transfers control to an arbitrary token contract via transfer.
parameter to is credited in transfer.
parameter tokens is the amount debited and credited in transfer.
parameter spender indexes the allowance written by approve.
parameter tokens is the allowance amount set by approve.
parameter from is the source account debited by transferFrom.
parameter to is the destination account credited by transferFrom.
parameter tokens is the amount moved by transferFrom.
parameter spender indexes the allowance written by approveAndCall.
parameter tokens is the allowance amount set by approveAndCall.
parameter data is accepted by approveAndCall.
parameter tokenAddress selects the external contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
parameter tokens is the amount forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.
parameter tokenOwner indexes balances in balanceOf.
parameter tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
parameter _newOwner is stored into newOwner by transferOwnership.
parameter spender is the target contract of the external receiveApproval call.
parameter data is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
parameter tokenAddress is the target contract of the external ERC20 transfer call.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter to exists only to supply the recipient of transfer; fold it into the transfer function node.
Parameter tokens exists only as the transfer amount consumed by transfer.
Parameter spender exists only as the allowance key written by approve.
Parameter tokens exists only as the allowance value written by approve.
Parameter from exists only as the debited source account in transferFrom.
Parameter to exists only as the credited destination account in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens exists only as the moved amount in transferFrom.
Parameter spender uniquely determines the external call target in approveAndCall, so merge into that unsafe operation.
Parameter tokens exists only as the allowance value written by approveAndCall.
Parameter data is passed directly into the external receiveApproval call, so merge into that unsafe operation.
Parameter tokenAddress uniquely determines the external call target, so merge into the external ERC20 call unsafe operation.
Parameter tokens exists only as the amount forwarded by transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter tokenOwner exists only as the lookup key for balanceOf.
Parameter tokenOwner exists only as the first lookup key for allowance.
Parameter spender exists only as the second lookup key for allowance.
Parameter _newOwner exists only to be stored into newOwner by transferOwnership.
